test_cases.tc_title: BTSA default Repeat All on playback
test_cases.pre_conditions:
1. BTSA device connected and selected.
2. Playlist has >=2 items.
test_cases.test_procedure:
1. Start playback from BTSA.
2. Check the Repeat mode indicator.
test_cases.expected_result:
1. Playback starts.
2. Repeat mode is Repeat All (softkey highlighted, label 'Repeat All').
test_cases.test_item: The HU shall set the BTSA device to Repeat All by default when playback is initiated.

test_cases.tc_title: BTSA Repeat All loops to first
test_cases.pre_conditions:
1. BTSA Repeat All active.
2. Positioned on last item.
test_cases.test_procedure:
1. Let the last item finish.
2. Check which item plays next.
test_cases.expected_result: 1. The first item of the playlist starts playing.
test_cases.test_item: In Repeat All mode the HU shall continue from the first item after the last.

test_cases.test_procedure:
1. Let the current item finish.
2. Check which item plays next.
test_cases.expected_result: 1. The same item restarts from the beginning.
test_cases.test_item: In Repeat Song mode the HU shall restart the current item from the beginning.

test_cases.test_procedure:
1. Read the Repeat softkey state and label.
2. Check that the softkey is highlighted with label 'Repeat Song'.
test_cases.expected_result: 1. Repeat softkey is highlighted with label 'Repeat Song'.
test_cases.test_item: While in Repeat Song state the HU shall display the Repeat softkey highlighted.

test_cases.tc_title: BTSA Repeat persists until off or disconnect
test_cases.test_procedure:
1. Skip across several items without touching Repeat.
2. Check the Repeat state.
3. Disconnect the BTSA device.
4. Check the Repeat state after reconnect.
test_cases.expected_result:
1. Repeat stays active across items.
2. After disconnect the Repeat state resets per spec.
test_cases.design_method: 基礎故障注入 (Fault Injection Lite)
test_cases.test_item: Repeat Song/All shall stay active until deactivated or the device disconnects (PC4.4).
test_cases.split_reason: SPEC PC4.4 持續性,需求未拆,需 Gate① 確認重連後行為

test_cases.test_procedure:
1. Read the Repeat softkey state.
2. Check that the softkey shows the OFF (not highlighted) state.
test_cases.expected_result: 1. Repeat softkey shows OFF state (not highlighted).
test_cases.test_item: While in Repeat Off state the HU shall display the Repeat softkey in the OFF state.

test_cases.pre_conditions:
1. Source A (BTSA) with Repeat All on.
2. Source B previously Repeat Off.
test_cases.test_procedure:
1. Switch to source B.
2. Check source B Repeat state.
3. Switch back to source A.
4. Check source A Repeat state.
test_cases.expected_result:
1. Source B shows its own Repeat Off.
2. Source A still shows Repeat All.
test_cases.test_item: Repeat shall be source dependent: switching source retains each source's Repeat state (PC4.4.1).
test_cases.split_reason: SPEC PC4.4.1 來源相依,需求未拆

test_cases.pre_conditions: 1. BTSA device that does not support Repeat.
test_cases.test_procedure:
1. Read the Repeat softkey state.
2. Check that the softkey shows the Unavailable (greyed) state.
test_cases.test_item: While Repeat is unavailable the HU shall display the Repeat softkey in the Unavailable state.
